name: creator_content_plan
description: Creator/Seller pack: a 7-day content plan saved as a Word document and tracked in memory. Use for 'plan my content for next week', 'content calendar for my brand', 'what should I post this week', 'what's on my content plan'.
instructions: To make a plan: 1. Ask only for what is missing: niche or product, platforms, posts per day, and any launch or sale date. 2. Plan 7 days starting tomorrow (or the start date given): each day has the platform, a post idea with a hook, the format (short video, carousel, story, text) and a call to action; mix teaching, behind-the-scenes, social proof the user really has, and selling posts (no more than 2 selling days). 3. Call write_file with path 'Content/Content plan <YYYY-MM-DD>.docx'. 4. For each post call remember_fact with category 'goal', key 'content:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<short title>' and content 'Content plan: <YYYY-MM-DD> / <platform> / <short title> / status idea'. When the user says a post is done or posted, update that line with the same key and 'status posted'. When they ask what's planned, call memory_search for 'Content plan:' and list the next 3 not yet posted. Keep spoken answers short.
